featured_reviews.name: Uzma Syed
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a student of Psychology at Patkar-Varde College, I have experienced a highly supportive, empathetic, and intellectually stimulating environment that truly nurtures both personal and academic growth. I am truly grateful to our HoD, Ms. Pranali Manikeri for being emotionally available for us and creating a safe space where students feel comfortable expressing themselves.

Throughout my journey, I have never felt hesitant to ask questions or clarify doubts. The Psych Dept truly feels like our own space, where every student not only learns but also grows and heals.

One of the most valuable opportunities I received was presenting my research papers at the Confab Multidisciplinary International Conference for three consecutive years. I was also honored with the “Best Paper Presenter” award for my research paper titled “The Evolutionary Basis of Fear of Missing Out (FOMO) and Its Impact on Mating Choices and Strategies”, under the guidance of Pranali Ma'am, for which I'll always be very grateful.

I have been a student at Patkar College for the past seven years, and I can confidently say that it has been an incredibly enriching journey. The faculty members and staff are highly approachable, helpful, and always willing to guide students whenever needed. Their constant support has played a significant role in my academic development.
I would also like to appreciate the college’s security system. The presence and dedication of the guards have always made us feel safe on campus.

Overall, Patkar has not just provided me with a degree, but also with valuable experiences, recognition, and lifelong learning. I would highly recommend the Psychology program here to anyone looking for a supportive, empathetic, and growth-oriented academic environment.

featured_reviews.name: Shreya Pravin Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am an alumna of the Biotechnology Department at Chikitsak Samuhas Patkar-Varde College, and I can confidently say it is one of the most advanced and well-structured courses offered by the college. The department provides extensive hands-on experience, starting from fundamental wet lab techniques to more advanced experimental and dry lab approaches, which really helps build a strong practical foundation.
Some of the key experiments we performed during our Bachelor's included DNA isolation, gel electrophoresis, PCR techniques, microbial culturing, enzyme assays, chromatography, and basic bioinformatics analysis. This combination of practical exposure and theoretical understanding truly prepares students for higher studies and research.
The lectures are well-paced, easy to understand, and conducted in a timely and organized manner. The faculty members are extremely approachable and always willing to help, ensuring that every student keeps up with the concepts effectively.
Apart from academics, the department actively organizes seminars, workshops, and co-curricular activities that enhance learning beyond the classroom. One of the highlights is the departmental trip, which is always memorable, enjoyable, and a great way to bond with peers and faculty.
Overall, the Biotechnology Department offers a holistic learning experience, blending academics, practical exposure, and extracurricular activities seamlessly.
